explanation: For each anchor point, count later points by reduced integer slope, normalizing direction and handling vertical lines separately. Count coincident points independently and add them to the most common slope through that anchor.
timeComplexity: O(n^2 log M) expected time when coordinate differences have magnitude at most M, including GCD reductions.
